taiwan_aviation.headline: 中國東方航空A330-300抵達桃園 站內180天未見相同組合
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開 ADS-B 資料顯示，中國東方航空A330-300於11月27日抵達桃園，系統記錄確認時間為06:10:12 UTC。本站過去180天未記錄相同營運者、機型與機場組合；本次紀錄未經獨立第二來源交叉確認。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Eastern A330-300 Arrives at Taoyuan, No Matching Site Combination in 180 Days
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public ADS-B data show that a China Eastern A330-300 arrived at Taoyuan on Nov. 27, with the system recording confirmation at 06:10:12 UTC. The site had no record of the same operator, aircraft type and airport combination in the preceding 180 days; no independent second source cross-checked this observation.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空規劃現金增資3億股 募資主要用於償還銀行借款
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空公告現金增資，預計發行3億股，每股新臺幣15.5元，募資總額約新臺幣46.5億元，主要用於償還銀行借款；增資將透過員工、原股東認購及公開承銷辦理，配額分別為10%、80%及10%。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux Plans 300 Million-Share Capital Increase, Proceeds Mainly to Repay Bank Loans
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux announced a cash capital increase, planning to issue 300 million shares at NT$15.5 each and raise about NT$4.65 billion, mainly to repay bank loans. The planned allocation is 10% for employee subscriptions, 80% for existing shareholders and 10% for public underwriting.

international_aviation.headline: 西南航空2026年最長737橫貫航線為波士頓—舊金山 平均2,704英里
international_aviation.summary: Cirium 2026年數據顯示，波士頓洛根—舊金山是西南航空最長的美國本土橫貫航線，平均2,704英里；前三名航線差距僅15英里，737 MAX 8為這些航線的主力機型。
international_aviation.headline_en: Southwest's Longest 2026 737 Transcontinental Route Is Boston–San Francisco at 2,704 Miles
international_aviation.summary_en: Cirium's 2026 data identify Boston Logan–San Francisco as Southwest's longest domestic transcontinental route, averaging 2,704 miles. The top three routes are separated by only 15 miles, and the 737 MAX 8 is the primary aircraft on these routes.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司將聲請破產 所有航班已取消
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways於11月27日確認，其挪威營運子公司Norse Atlantic Airways AS未能籌得足以維持營運的資金，董事會決定向挪威Agder District Court聲請破產。Norse Atlantic已取消所有航班並停止售票，復飛日期尚未確認；上市母公司Norse Atlantic ASA及英國營運子公司不在此次破產程序內。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian Operating Subsidiary to File for Bankruptcy, All Flights Cancelled
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic Airways confirmed on Nov. 27 that its Norwegian operating subsidiary, Norse Atlantic Airways AS, would seek bankruptcy after failing to secure enough funding to keep operating. Norse Atlantic has cancelled all flights and stopped ticket sales, with no resumption date confirmed; listed parent Norse Atlantic ASA and the UK operating subsidiary are outside the announced proceedings.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic申請破產並暫停所有航班 復飛時間未公布
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic已申請破產並暫停所有航班，復飛時間尚未公布。巴基斯坦國際航空（PIA）先前使用Norse Atlantic的波音787-9客機執飛英國航線，兩家公司10月簽署涵蓋兩架Dreamliner的濕租協議，以擴大英國與巴基斯坦間的運能；PIA表示將自11月26日起以自有波音777營運所有英國航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic Files for Bankruptcy and Suspends All Flights, Resumption Date Unannounced
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic had filed for bankruptcy and suspended all flights; no resumption date had been announced. PIA had used Norse Atlantic Boeing 787-9s on UK services, and the airlines signed an October wet-lease agreement for two Dreamliners to expand UK–Pakistan capacity. PIA said it would operate all UK flights with its own Boeing 777s from Nov. 26.

international_aviation.headline: Norse Atlantic挪威營運子公司申請破產 母公司與英國子公司目前未受影響
international_aviation.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways AS於2026年11月27日宣布已向挪威Agder District Court申請破產，因未能籌得履行短期財務義務所需資金。程序迄今未影響上市母公司Norse Atlantic ASA及英國營運子公司；Norse Atlantic Airways同週稍早已執行最後航班並停飛全數機隊。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian Operating Subsidiary Files for Bankruptcy, Parent and UK Unit Unaffected So Far
international_aviation.summary_en: Norse Atlantic Airways AS announced on Nov. 27, 2026, that it had filed for bankruptcy with Agder District Court in Norway after failing to secure enough funds to meet short-term obligations. The proceedings had not so far affected listed parent Norse Atlantic ASA or the UK operating subsidiary. Norse Atlantic Airways had operated its last flights and grounded its entire fleet earlier that week.
